## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [Harness](../../projects/Harness.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Public product and project documentation suggests a worktree/agent-session correlation and independent-verification workflow; no open Desktop implementation, supported Linux version, source-level integration seam or measured benefit. Ограничения: Desktop is macOS-only, proprietary and not source-auditable; Git worktrees alone do not isolate OS users/credentials/network; MCP can spawn sessions and public examples suggest unsafe flags/push/merge. No runtime integration or safety certification. Следующий тест: A existing Bazzite CLI/Git worktrees and GitHub draft PR control, B independent paper-level issue/session/worker/verifier lineage with frozen synthetic fixtures and idempotency/timeout gates; compare accepted-PR quality, duplicate starts, abandoned worktrees, resource load and owner time. Desktop C not available on Linux. [Основание](../../portfolio/2026-11-24/lanes.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
